page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.48xlarge is an x86_64 enterprise-grade virtual server from the Enhanced instance family. It is equipped with 192 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is allocated 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 5.33 GB of RAM per virtual processor, managed on a KVM hypervisor platform.

Network connectivity is anchored by a baseline bandwidth capability of 100 Gbps, accommodating high-throughput data ingress and egress. The server does not bundle local disk storage or hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for persistent data requirements. The absence of local solid-state drives minimizes disk maintenance overhead while necessitating proper network storage volume provisioning.

From a resource density perspective, the pairing of 192 dedicated compute threads with 1024 GB of RAM and 100 Gbps networking positions this server for large-scale enterprise deployments without hardware accelerator overhead. Suitable workloads include large in-memory databases, clustered enterprise resource planning systems, distributed analytics, high-traffic application tiers, and compute-heavy container orchestrations.
